name: Send HTML Email (Gmail)
description: Delivery-pattern HTML email sender: reads {html, subject} from the upstream compose node, RFC 2047-encodes the subject, and sends via the Gmail API. DRY_RUN-gated.
author: Talos
requirements: Gmail OAuth access token with gmail.send scope (referenced via vault:// in AUTH_HEADER)
Recipient address in TO; subject + html supplied by the upstream compose node
